messages.author: 920bff22da3daa67
messages.subject: restricted unstructured covariance matrix
parts:
I'm now searching for this topic for a while but I cannot find the solution: I want to impose a restriction on an unstructured covariance matrix (i.e. restricting the first variance to a fixed value say 1). I know fixing a variance parameter can be done via "fixed = TRUE" and setting the corresponding initial value. However, for the unstructured covariance matrix I get the warning "Wishart prior is not corrected to account for 1 fixed hyperparameters." I have no idea how this is handled in INLA (maybe there is even a more elegant option of how to handle a restricted covariance matrix).
Many thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] restricted unstructured covariance matrix
parts:
we do not have any options for doing this for the Wishart prior; you
have to 'emulate' this by the parameters of the Wishart prior itself.
